description: Enforcement-doctrine gate 2 (pre-bash half): the orchestrator (main thread) must NOT run multi-step / heavy build/test/install Bash inline — delegate it to a subagent. Read-only inspection (git status, gh pr view, ls/cat/grep) is fine. A heavy/multi-step command WARNS first, then BLOCKS a repeat. SUBAGENTS are EXEMPT (CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION). Honest escape hatch: ALLOW_ORCHESTRATOR_WORK=1 + ALLOW_ORCHESTRATOR_WORK_REASON='why', or an inline `# orchestrator-work-ok: why`. on_error=open.
